description: This file contains utility functions for message handling, content type inference, file extraction, schema dereferencing, and message manipulation within the 'litellm' project. It includes functions for converting message formats, managing conversation state, extracting files, and handling content types, tailored for integration with various LLM providers and message schemas.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] handle_any_messages_to_chat_completion_str_messages_conversion( messages: Any, )
methods.description: Converts various message formats (list, dict, str) into a list of string dictionaries suitable for chat completions.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] handle_messages_with_content_list_to_str_conversion( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Converts message content lists to concatenated strings.

methods.name: AllMessageValues strip_name_from_message(message: AllMessageValues, allowed_name_roles: List[str] = ["user"])
methods.description: Removes 'name' attribute from a message unless its role is in the allowed list.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] strip_name_from_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], allowed_name_roles: List[str] = ["user"] )
methods.description: Removes 'name' attribute from messages based on allowed roles.

methods.name: AllMessageValues strip_none_values_from_message(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Removes None values from a message dictionary.

methods.name: str convert_content_list_to_str( message: Union[AllMessageValues, ChatCompletionResponseMessage], )
methods.description: Concatenates content lists within messages into a single string.

methods.name: str get_str_from_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Concatenates multiple messages into a single string.

methods.name: bool is_non_content_values_set(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Checks if non-content fields in a message are set.

methods.name: bool _audio_or_image_in_message_content(message: AllMessageValues)
methods.description: Checks if message content contains audio or image types.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] convert_openai_message_to_only_content_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Converts OpenAI-like messages into message-only content dictionaries.

methods.name: str get_content_from_model_response(response: Union[ModelResponse, dict])
methods.description: Extracts concatenated content from model response objects.

methods.name: Optional[Literal["user","assistant"]] detect_first_expected_role( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Determines the next expected role ('user' or 'assistant') based on message sequence.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _insert_user_continue_message( messages: List[AllMessageValues], user_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionUserMessage], ensure_alternating_roles: bool, )
methods.description: Inserts a user continue message in the message sequence to maintain role alternation.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _insert_assistant_continue_message( messages: List[AllMessageValues], assistant_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionAssistantMessage] = None, ensure_alternating_roles: bool = True, )
methods.description: Inserts assistant continue messages between consecutive user messages.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] get_completion_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], assistant_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionAssistantMessage], user_continue_message: Optional[ChatCompletionUserMessage], ensure_alternating_roles: bool, )
methods.description: Ensures messages alternate roles by inserting placeholder messages.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_format_from_file_id(file_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Determines format string based on file ID, especially for unified IDs.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] update_messages_with_model_file_ids( messages: List[AllMessageValues], model_id: str, model_file_id_mapping: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]], )
methods.description: Updates message contents with provider-specific file IDs.

methods.name: Union[str,List[Dict[str,Any]]] update_responses_input_with_model_file_ids( input: Any, )
methods.description: Updates API input payloads with provider-specific file IDs, decoding unified IDs when necessary.

methods.description: Infers MIME type from URL extension, content signature, or fallback, used for file content detection.

methods.description: Parses message text for embedded reasoning content separated by custom tags.
